posts.title: Luna Tanning | Restarting repeat-visit behaviour

copy.default:
A regular customer can disappear without ever becoming dissatisfied.

That matters for repeat-visit businesses.

The useful signal here wasn't just “has this person bought before?” It was whether their normal visit rhythm had broken.

That changed the reactivation strategy.

222Emails identified customers outside their usual pattern, gave them an easy reason to return, and focused on restarting the habit rather than overselling the next visit.

This is one of the cleaner examples of why retention isn't always a persuasion problem.

Sometimes the customer simply needs a route back into the routine.

posts.mediaAlt: 222Emails client case study for Luna Tanning showing a 14-day repeat-visit reactivation campaign, re-engaged clients, package conversations, booked visits and attributable potential booking value.
